fact: 20世纪初巴黎证券交易所的场内会员只有70名法定经纪人（agents de change），他们凭政府授权对政府证券及其他正式挂牌证券的交易、以及汇票等信用票据的贴现享有绝对垄断；非本人直接交易须通过这些经纪人办理。

sources.title: W. C. Van Antwerp, The Stock Exchange from Within (Doubleday, Page & Company, 1914), chapter X "The Paris Bourse; a Monopoly Under Government" (Project Gutenberg eBook #60082)
sources.quote: The Bourse in Paris differs from all others in that its membership consists of but seventy. These Agents de Change, as they are called, enjoy an absolute monopoly not only to trade in government and other officially listed securities, but also to negotiate bills of exchange and similar instruments of credit.

sources.title: W. C. Van Antwerp, The Stock Exchange from Within (Doubleday, Page & Company, 1914), chapter X "The Paris Bourse; a Monopoly Under Government" (Project Gutenberg eBook #60082)
sources.quote: in Paris, where the seventy Agents de Change enjoy an absolute monopoly by government authority

fact: 依1900年10月7日法令，巴黎证券交易所的法定经纪人必须是年满25岁、享有民事与政治权利的法国公民，须由共和国总统签署法令任命，完成兵役，并取得多家银行与商号签署的品行与适任证明；外国穿越者不能直接取得该场内职业资格。

sources.title: W. C. Van Antwerp, The Stock Exchange from Within (Doubleday, Page & Company, 1914), chapter X "The Paris Bourse; a Monopoly Under Government" (Project Gutenberg eBook #60082)
sources.quote: These laws provide that Agents de Change of the Paris Bourse must be French citizens over twenty-five years of age, and in possession of civil and political rights; they must be nominated by official decree signed by the President of the Republic. They must have performed their military service or satisfied the law as to such service, they must produce a certificate of fitness and good character signed by the heads of several banking and commercial firms.

fact: 巴黎证券交易所的经纪垄断制度由1900年10月7日法令确立，该法令规范《商法典》第90条的执行，并以1885年3月28日法律和1898年1月29日法令修订；法定经纪人在实质上是政府官员，其70个席位由部长会议任命并独家经办政府证券。

sources.title: W. C. Van Antwerp, The Stock Exchange from Within (Doubleday, Page & Company, 1914), chapter X "The Paris Bourse; a Monopoly Under Government" (Project Gutenberg eBook #60082)
sources.quote: It exists by virtue of the decree of October 7, 1900, regulating the execution of article 90 of the Code du Commerce and of the law of March 28, 1885, as modified by the decree of January 29, 1898.

sources.title: W. C. Van Antwerp, The Stock Exchange from Within (Doubleday, Page & Company, 1914), chapter X "The Paris Bourse; a Monopoly Under Government" (Project Gutenberg eBook #60082)
sources.quote: Agents de Change are, in reality, officers of the government, since the seventy ministerial appointees are entrusted with the exclusive right of dealing in government securities

fact: 法国汽车工业在1902年达到年产7800辆、产值4700万法郎、出口值30219380法郎；同一统计序列显示，年产从1900年的4100辆（产值2300万法郎、出口6617360法郎）增至1905年的20500辆（产值1.4亿法郎、出口100265000法郎），法国汽车业在20世纪初经历了爆发式增长与出口扩张。

fact: 据《辩论日报》统计，1900年法国登记缴税的两座以上乘用车为1399辆、单双座小型车955辆，巴黎一地即有1845辆汽车，而马拉游览马车仍有6539辆；汽车在世纪之交的巴黎仍属少数，尚在替代马车的早期阶段。

sources.title: Francis Miltoun, The Automobilist Abroad (L.C. Page & Company, Boston, 1907) (Project Gutenberg eBook #26030)
sources.quote: In 1900 there were taxed in France 1,399 voitures-automobiles of more than two places, and 955 of one or two places... At the same period Paris alone claimed 1,845 voitures-automobiles and 6,539 horse-drawn pleasure carriages.

fact: 1902年的戈登-贝内特杯汽车赛被并入巴黎—维也纳拉力赛程、在因斯布鲁克收尾：英国车手埃奇驾驶纳皮尔赛车获胜，而潘哈德车队的德·克尼夫因传动齿轮（transmission gear）断裂而落败；法尔曼（Farman）驾驶70马力潘哈德赢得巴黎—维也纳全程。

sources.title: Francis Miltoun, The Automobilist Abroad (L.C. Page & Company, Boston, 1907) (Project Gutenberg eBook #26030)
sources.quote: In 1902 the Gordon-Bennett formed a part of the Paris-Vienna itinerary, the finish being at Innsbruck in the Tyrol. De Knyff in a Panhard had victory well within his grasp when, by a misfortune in the parting of his transmission gear, he was beaten by Edge in the English Napier... Through to Vienna the race was won by Farman in a seventy-horse-power Panhard

fact: 1902年阿登环路赛（Circuit des Ardennes）由驾驶70马力潘哈德的雅罗（Jarrot）夺冠，全程约450公里，平均时速约54.5英里；加布里埃尔驾驶莫尔斯紧随其后直到最后一圈。

sources.title: Francis Miltoun, The Automobilist Abroad (L.C. Page & Company, Boston, 1907) (Project Gutenberg eBook #26030)
sources.quote: In the Circuit des Ardennes event in 1902, Jarrot, in a seventy-horse Panhard, and Gabriel in a Mors, were practically tied until the last round, when Jarrot finally won, having made the entire distance (approximately 450 kilometres) at an average speed of fifty-four and a half miles per hour.
